nary_nodes.label: Samsung's Q2 2026 profit jump
evidence: South Korean technology giant Samsung Electronics says it expects to post a 19-fold jump in its profits, driven by global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) memory chips.
The company forecast that it made 89.4tn won (£43.6bn; $58.4bn) between the start of April and the end of June, marking its third record quarterly operating profits in a row.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Profit jumps are business-related events, fitting schema.org BusinessEvent for corporate financial events.

nary_nodes.label: Samsung/SK Hynix $880bn investment plan
evidence: In June, South Korea unveiled plans for at least $880bn of investments in projects led by Samsung and SK Hynix to build out the country's chip manufacturing in the coming years.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Investment plans are corporate business events, matching schema.org BusinessEvent definition.

nary_nodes.label: Samsung shares fall 7% in July 2026
evidence: Samsung's shares fell by almost 7% in Seoul on Tuesday as some investors had expected its profits to have been even higher.
in July 2026

nary_nodes.label: Best quarterly performance ever
evidence: The company's projected earnings mark one of 'the best quarterly performances ever', which was close to the tech sector record set by Nvidia earlier this year, said industry analyst Marc Einstein from Counterpoint Research.

nary_nodes.label: Nvidia shares fall after record sales
evidence: In May, Nvidia posted record quarterly sales and profits, with revenue between January and March topping $80bn. But Nvidia's stock fell at the time, in what some analysts said was a sign that investors were increasingly worried about rising competition in the sector.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Stock price changes are business-related events, aligning with schema.org BusinessEvent for corporate financial events.

nary_nodes.label: Kospi index surge in 2026
evidence: The strong performance of both companies has helped lift the value of South Korea's benchmark share index, the Kospi, by more than 80% this year.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Market performance (stock index movement) is a business event related to financial markets.
